name: agile-sprint-drain
description: Sprint-drain orchestrator for Claude Code — runs the active sprint to a fixed point by auto-alternating agile-10-implement (build queue) and agile-11-merge-train (merge queue) until the Jira dependency graph is fully resolved. A progress guard stops with a report instead of spinning on a permanently-blocked ticket. Requires the agile-execution and agile-merge-review plugins installed. Needs the gh CLI + Atlassian MCP.
